Having recently moved to Rome and having three cats, I was desperately looking for a capable veterinarian.
After frantically calling dozens of volunteers, Dr. Lomonaco was the most highly recommended.
I took my cat to the vet for some suspected growths under her tail, which turned out to be just shrunken feces; I felt like burying myself out of shame and embarrassment. The doctor cleaned her and didn't ask for anything, not even for me to buy the entire staff a coffee.
Nothing more needs to be said.

I've been taking my furry friends to Dr. Lomonaco for over 20 years, and every time it's a confirmation. He's an excellent doctor and, above all, a wonderful person with enormous humanity and sensitivity. I can't thank him enough for everything he's done for me over the years, and especially in these last few days.
Very knowledgeable and helpful

I've been a client of Dr. Lomonaco for many years, and I've always been happy with him. For 17 years, when I needed him for my first "love," Snoopy, the doctor has always been excellent, helpful, and human, as he still is with my little Maltese princess! I'd say he's the best! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🐾🐾 Sissy …

Very competent, friendly, and always available. Appointments are required.
I recommend anyone who needs a veterinarian to come here; they certainly won't regret it.
Excellent Doctor, and incredibly human!

My cat was very ill; I rushed to the clinic, but the hours on Google were wrong, so it initially appeared closed. I waited for it to open. The visit lasted ten minutes without any in-depth tests, and he prescribed a paste for heartburn. Two days later, I was taken to another facility, where he underwent emergency surgery for a foreign body in his intestines.
An exceptionally skilled and competent veterinarian. I've known him for over 20 years. I've always enjoyed working with Dr. Lomonaco and his entire staff.
Dr. Lomonaco is a fantastic veterinarian who loves animals.

Very professional and kind. Clean environment. The waiting room, however, cannot accommodate pet owners who "linger" WITHOUT APPOINTMENTS, demanding visits for non-urgent cases, even after hours! This creates "apprehension" and fear for those who have made regular appointments, especially regarding the presence of several animals. YET ALL YOU NEED TO DO IS EMAIL TO MAKE AN APPOINTMENT! IF I WERE A PROFESSIONAL, I WOULD NOT VISIT THOSE WITHOUT APPOINTMENTS, especially after hours, like everyone else does.
The best vet in Rome...

Very knowledgeable and talented, you can tell he loves animals.
Top!!!

There are no words. You have to know him.
The Leonardo da Vinci of veterinarians.

Dr. Roberto Lomonaco was exceptional throughout our dog Maya's life journey. I highly recommend this practice for many reasons, especially the Doctor's humane approach. Thank you so much for these years. I'm sure Maya will have understood that she was brought to his practice for loving care, and now she'll be saying goodbye to us all in a better place.
